about.title: Digital habits.
about.description: Computers are part of almost everything we do at work, but we rarely think about the energy and resources they use.
about.caption: A research project at LUT University, exploring a desktop companion that helps people understand their digital habits and make more sustainable everyday choices.

card.tag: A companion for your digital life

challenge.title: The hidden cost
challenge.description: What happens on a screen can feel weightless. The resources behind it are very real.
challenge.caption: Idle computers, unnecessary background activity, and growing file collections can use resources without us noticing. Awareness is the first step towards a more considered digital routine.

card.tag: The impact we don’t always see

image.alt: Solar panels and the energy behind our digital lives

solution.title: Understand your impact.
solution.description: A clearer picture of energy, storage, and digital behaviour. Thoughtful guidance for what to do next.
solution.caption: The proposed companion brings together local activity monitoring, a Digital Sustainability Score, and practical recommendations. Core monitoring and scoring stay on your device; AI-enhanced explanations are optional.
